name: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. was formed with the primary goal of undertaking strategic corporate transactions. This encompasses a broad spectrum of business combinations, including but not limited to mergers, share exchanges, the acquisition of assets or stock, recapitalizations, or reorganizations, to integrate with one or more target entities. The company commenced operations in 2023 and maintains its headquarters in Austin, Texas. It operates as a subsidiary of GSR IV Sponsor LLC.
